name: @ensemble/desktop
description: 合鸣 桌面应用（Electron 壳）

scripts.package: node scripts/gen-icon.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @ensemble/web build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:local: node scripts/gen-icon.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @ensemble/web build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:cloud: node scripts/gen-icon.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @ensemble/web build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.cloud.yml --publish never
